newsitem.title: USA: Duquesne delays Pa. power plant restart.
newsitem.headline: Duquesne delays Pa. power plant restart.

text.p: Duquesne Light Co said Monday it has delayed the restart for its 833 megawatt (MW) Beaver Valley 2 nuclear power plant until mid-November.
"The outage at Beaver Valley unit 2 will be extended for about five weeks from its scheduled restart of about October 14," said company spokesman Dennis O'Neil.
The unit, in Shippingport, Pa., was shut August 30 for maintenance and refueling.
O'Neil said the company needed more time to repair a leaking residual heat removal pump.
"The leak in the (pump's) seal was developed while the plant was being prepared for startup," he said.
The neighboring unit, Beaver Valley 1 (810 MW), was running normally.
